protocol_note: All 9 comparison methods are reproduced in pure PyTorch within the unified training framework from scratch (no pretrained weights, no DINO features), following docs/TRAINING_PLAN_BASELINES_20261022.md.

unet.name: U-Net
unet.authors: Olaf Ronneberger, Philipp Fischer, Thomas Brox
unet.title: U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation

architecture.normalization: BatchNorm2d (modern standard reproduction; original paper had no normalization, noted in report)

unetpp.name: UNet++
unetpp.authors: Zongwei Zhou, Md Mahfuzur Rahman Siddiquee, Nima Tajbakhsh, Jianming Liang
unetpp.title: UNet++: Redesigning Skip Connections to Exploit Multiscale Features in Image Segmentation
unetpp.venue: IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging (IEEE TMI)

pspnet.name: PSPNet
pspnet.authors: Hengshuang Zhao, Jianping Shi, Xiaojuan Qi, Xiaogang Wang, Jiaya Jia
pspnet.title: Pyramid Scene Parsing Network

architecture.backbone: ResNet-50 dilated (ResNetV1c deep 3x3 stem, output_stride=8, stage3 dilation=2, stage4 dilation=4)

deeplabv3p.name: DeepLabv3+
deeplabv3p.authors: Liang-Chieh Chen, Yukun Zhu, George Papandreou, Florian Schroff, Hartwig Adam
deeplabv3p.title: Encoder-Decoder with Atrous Separable Convolution for Semantic Image Segmentation

hrnet_w48.name: HRNet-W48
hrnet_w48.authors: Jingdong Wang, Ke Sun, Tianheng Cheng, Borui Jiang, Chaorui Deng, Yang Zhao, Dong Liu, Yadong Mu, Mingkui Tan, Xinggang Wang, Wenyu Liu, Bin Xiao
hrnet_w48.title: Deep High-Resolution Representation Learning for Visual Recognition
hrnet_w48.venue: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)

architecture.head: Concatenate 4 branches at 1/4 scale (720 ch) -> Conv3x3(720, 720) + BN + ReLU -> Conv1x1(720, 4)

segformer_b1.name: SegFormer-B1
segformer_b1.authors: Enze Xie, Wenhai Wang, Zhiding Yu, Anima Anandkumar, Jose M. Alvarez, Ping Luo
segformer_b1.title: SegFormer: Simple and Efficient Design for Semantic Segmentation with Transformers

architecture.decoder: All-MLP decoder (decoder_dim=256, 4 levels upsampled to 1/4 scale -> Conv1x1(1024, 256) + BN + ReLU -> Conv1x1(256, 4))

mask2former.name: Mask2Former
mask2former.authors: Bowen Cheng, Ishan Misra, Alexander G. Schwing, Alexander Kirillov, Rohit Girdhar
mask2former.title: Masked-attention Mask Transformer for Universal Image Segmentation

architecture.pixel_decoder: MSDeformAttnPixelDecoder: 6-layer multi-scale deformable attention encoder over 1/8, 1/16, 1/32 features (embed_dims=256, num_heads=8, ffn_dim=1024, n_levels=3, n_points=4) + FPN lateral fusion with 1/4 feature to produce mask_features (256 ch)
architecture.transformer_decoder: 9-layer Masked-Attention Transformer decoder (100 learnable queries, embed_dims=256, num_heads=8, ffn_dim=2048, order: Masked Cross-Attn -> Self-Attn -> FFN, deep supervision across initial + 9 layers)

mask2former.loss: Original Mask2Former objective: 2.0*CE (weighted mean, no-object weight 0.1) + 5.0*point BCE + 5.0*point Dice (12544 importance-sampled points, oversample 3.0, importance 0.75, full-resolution GT masks), summed over the initial prediction and all 9 decoder layers; no extra per-pixel semantic loss.
mask2former.protocol_deviation: Unified protocol optimizer (AdamW lr 2.8e-4, wd 1e-4, grad clip 1.0, 3000 updates, batch 8, no pretraining) instead of the original recipe (AdamW lr 1e-4, wd 0.05, clip 0.01, 160k iterations, ImageNet backbone).
mask2former.revision_20261023: v1 (plan_v1_20261022.json) trained nothing with this method; its loss was 0.5*CE+0.5*Dice on semantic logits + 0.2 * layer-mean Mask2Former loss with 1/4-resolution GT, which did not match this entry.

ddp.name: DDP
ddp.authors: Yuanfeng Ji, Zhe Chen, Enze Xie, Lanqing Hong, Xihui Liu, Zhaoqiang Liu, Tong Lu, Zhenguo Li, Ping Luo
ddp.title: DDP: Diffusion Model for Dense Visual Prediction

verified_details.backbone_and_neck: ResNet-50 ([256, 512, 1024, 2048]) + FPN (out_channels=256, GN 32 groups, 4 outs) + MultiStageMerging (upsample 4 levels to 1/4 scale, concat 1024 -> Conv1x1(1024, 256) + GN 32). Chosen to match the ResNet-50 family used by PSPNet/DeepLabv3+/Mask2Former under the no-pretraining protocol.
verified_details.label_encoding: Class Embedding table nn.Embedding(num_classes + 1, 256) at 1/4 resolution, scaled via (sigmoid(emb) * 2 - 1) * bit_scale with official semantic segmentation bit_scale = 0.01 (segmentation/mmseg/models/segmentors/ddp.py lines 825, 900-901).
verified_details.noise_schedule: Continuous-time cosine log-SNR schedule alpha_cosine_log_snr(t, ns=0.0002, ds=0.00025), alpha = sqrt(sigmoid(log_snr)), sigma = sqrt(sigmoid(-log_snr)) (ddp.py lines 769-775).
verified_details.training_timestep_distribution: Uniform continuous sampling t ~ U(0, 0.999) (sample_range=(0, 0.999), ddp.py lines 810, 904-905).
verified_details.decode_head: transform Conv1x1(512, 256) on cat([x, noised_gt], dim=1); time_mlp LearnedSinusoidalPosEmb(16) -> Linear(17, 1024) -> GELU -> Linear(1024, 1024); DeformableHeadWithTime with 6-layer DetrTransformerEncoder (embed_dims=256, num_heads=8, feedforward_channels=1024, num_levels=1, n_points=4, SinePositionalEncoding(128), per-layer time scale-shift MLP) -> Conv1x1(256, 4).
verified_details.auxiliary_head: FCNHead on neck feature x (256 -> 256 -> 4) with loss_weight = 0.4 (ddp_convnext_t_4x4_512x1024_160k_cityscapes.py lines 44-56).
verified_details.inference_sampler_and_steps: DDIM sampler with timesteps = 3, randsteps = 1, time_difference = 1, sample_range = (0, 0.999) (official main benchmark default in configs/cityscapes/ and configs/ade/).
verified_details.self_aligned_denoising: Not used (in official repo, self-aligned denoising is only a separate 5k post-finetuning config; main 160k benchmark uses standard training).

ddp.training_note: grad_accum_steps=2 (2x4, effective batch 8, 3000 updates); BN micro-batch 4 in the ResNet-50 backbone and auxiliary head (neck uses GroupNorm). Selected by verification check 3 (batch-8 micro-batches exceeded 22.5 GiB or OOM); revision 2026-10-23.

ccdm.name: CCDM
ccdm.authors: Lukas Zbinden, Lars Doorenbos, Theodoros Pissas, Adrian Thomas Huber, Raphael Sznitman, Pablo Marquez-Neila
ccdm.title: Stochastic Segmentation with Conditional Categorical Diffusion Models

verified_details.diffusion_timesteps_T: T = 250 discrete timesteps with Hoogeboom et al. (2021) cosine schedule (s = 0.008), beta_t = min(1 - cumalpha_t / cumalpha_{t-1}, 0.999), alpha_t = 1 - beta_t (params.yml line 48, ddpm/models/diffusion_denoising.py lines 341-355).
verified_details.forward_and_posterior: Forward q(x_t | x_0) = cumalpha_t * x_0 + (1 - cumalpha_t) / K; exact categorical reverse posterior theta_post(x_t, x_0, t) proportional to (alpha_t * x_t + (1 - alpha_t) / K) * (cumalpha_{t-1} * x_0 + (1 - cumalpha_{t-1}) / K) (diffusion_denoising.py lines 396-444).
verified_details.denoising_network: OpenAI ADM U-Net (create_unet_openai in ddpm/models/unet_openai/): in_channels = num_classes + 3 = 7, out_channels = 4 with Softmax output x0_pred; base_channels = 64, channel_mult = (0.5, 1, 1, 2, 2, 4, 4) for 512x512 (stage channels [32, 64, 64, 128, 128, 256, 256]), num_res_blocks = 2, GroupNorm, attention at the 3 innermost resolutions (32x32, 16x16, 8x8) with num_head_channels = 32.
verified_details.conditioning_mode: Direct pixel concatenation th.cat([x_t, image], dim=1) at U-Net input with feature_cond_encoder.type = 'none' (params.yml line 50, unet.py line 588), strictly complying with no-pretraining and no-DINO rules.
verified_details.loss_composition: Categorical posterior KL divergence D_KL(q(x_{t-1} | x_t, x_0) || p_theta(x_{t-1} | x_t)) (trainer.py lines 266-280) combined with the unified protocol direct supervision 0.5 * CE + 0.5 * foreground_Dice on logits.
verified_details.inference_steps: K = 10 evenly spaced reverse timesteps from T=250 down to 1 (stride sampling supported in diffusion_denoising.py lines 494-502 via np.linspace(T, 1, K).round(), using exact multi-step transition alpha_{t|s} = cumalpha_t / cumalpha_s).

ccdm.training_note: grad_accum_steps=2 (2x4, effective batch 8, 3000 updates); the ADM U-Net uses GroupNorm only, so accumulation does not change normalization statistics. Selected by verification check 3 (batch-8 micro-batches exceeded 22.5 GiB or OOM); revision 2026-10-23.
